grading_rules.any_match: Mode A/B post-correction only (correct if any stated value within tol)

meta.expansion: option (b): property + deterministic-reasoning surfaces added within registered strata (round-7 decision)

reference_frame_policy.band_gap: correct if final value within tol of PBE (MP) OR experimental reference; subjects with no experimental gap are DROPPED (PBE-only never graded alone)

tolerances.note: Literature-derived method-vs-experiment error bands (Hickey&Rowley 2014; Garza&Scuseria 2016; Kirklin 2015). NOT tuned to model outputs.
